offering_description.value: Operates casual steakhouses, sports bars and grills, and fast-casual chicken and burger restaurants for diners. Its company-run and franchised locations prepare meals for dine-in and takeout.

primary_products.value: Hand-cut steaks; ribs; burgers; pizzas; chicken sandwiches and tenders

primary_services.value: Dine-in restaurant service; takeout; restaurant franchising

customer_segment.value: B2C: Diners and takeout customers; B2B: Restaurant franchise operators

end_markets.value: Casual steakhouse dining; sports bar and grill dining; fast-casual dining

revenue_model.value: product sales: Prepared meals and drinks sold at company-run restaurants; licensing or royalties: Initial franchise fees and ongoing royalties paid by restaurant franchisees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Prepares and serves meals from purchased ingredients for dine-in and takeout customers; asset operator: Runs company-operated dining rooms, bars and kitchens that serve consumers; other: Provides restaurant concepts and operating systems to franchise operators

geography_served.value: global: United States and franchised locations in markets including Mexico, Asia and the Middle East

specialization.value: related lines: Casual steakhouses, sports bars and grills, and fast-casual chicken and burger restaurants

distribution_channels.value: own locations: Company-operated restaurants; partners / resellers: Domestic and international franchise operators; online: Restaurant websites and apps for takeout orders

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Food safety inspections by local health authorities and state alcohol licensing rules
